issue.title: test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed fails: five workspace snapshot sites are unreviewed

task_type_fields.why_not_flake:
Deterministic on clean master e6d44254b0 (2026-10-28), not a flake: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_agent_artifact_directory_operation_audit.py::test_artifact_directory_operation_sites_are_reviewed` fails on every run (also failed inside a 405-node batch where everything else passed). The set diff names five unreviewed artifact-directory operation sites that the workspace checkout-snapshot work introduced (42512dc116 adapter from bob-cli-df.4.1.1, then the toobig split bb9115b4e0):

- src/sase/workspace_provider/_snapshot_restore.py:_clear_worktree
- src/sase/workspace_provider/_snapshot_restore.py:_restore_operation_markers
- src/sase/workspace_provider/_snapshot_capture_payload.py:_cleanup_capture_temps
- src/sase/workspace_provider/_snapshot_capture_payload.py:_verify_pack
- src/sase/workspace_provider/_snapshot_capture_source.py:_discard_incomplete

`just check` hides it as FLAKY because tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt still lists this node under the old sase-n1 debt comment, but the current failure has a different root cause. Fix: review each site's directory operation (and its coverage declaration, see the sibling test_reviewed_dir_operation_sites_declare_coverage) and add it to the reviewed set in the audit test, or route it through an already-reviewed helper. Then drop the stale baseline entry if the node is green. bob-cli-df is closed, so no active epic owns this. Footprint phase sase-1p1.12--d first saw the node fail (witness e1d42fd027a7e99b9bc1b540b21e6d73), and the sase-1p1 land agent traced it to these sites.
